Loss report: gitlab -> gitea
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.push (the workflow rules admit the push source only on some branches, tags or variables, and Gitea has no ref filter for it; the jobs for that source do not start)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job and GHA does not; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-2 step.if: approximate expression translation (GitHub compares strings case-insensitively)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: branches: '**' (GHA fires a push without filters for branches and tags; branches are named explicitly to leave tags out or beside a tag filter)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
